CREATE TABLE pay_periods (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  start_date    DATE NOT NULL,
  end_date      DATE NOT NULL,
  status        pay_period_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  validated_at  TIMESTAMP,                         -- snapshot freeze time (UC-002)
  created_at    TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (end_date >= start_date)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- timesheets (UC-001 writes drafts, UC-002 validates/freezes, UC-003 reads frozen rows)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE timesheets (
  id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pay_period_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pay_periods(id),
  staff_id         UUID REFERENCES staff(id),      -- NULL = unmatched roster row (UC-001)
  roster_raw_name  VARCHAR(200),                   -- original roster label for unmatched rows
  total_hours      NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- ALL hours incl. OT/PH buckets below
  ot_hours         NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ph_hours         NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- public-holiday hours
  is_frozen        BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,  -- TRUE once UC-002 validates the period
  match_status     timesheet_match_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unmatched',
  created_at       TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (pay_period_id, staff_id)
);

CREATE TABLE timesheet_exceptions (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  timesheet_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES timesheets(id),
  rule_type     exception_rule_type NOT NULL,      -- UC-002 validation rules
  status        exception_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  note          TEXT,
  resolved_by   VARCHAR(120),
  created_at    TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pay_rates (read by UC-003; latest effective_from <= period end wins)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE pay_rates (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  staff_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES staff(id),
  hourly_rate     NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
  ot_multiplier   NUMERIC(4,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.5,
  ph_multiplier   NUMERIC(4,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.0,
  effective_from  DATE NOT NULL,
  created_at      TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- incentive_schemes (read by UC-003)
-- rule_definition JSON shape expected by incentiveEngine.js:
--   { "metrics": { "sessions": { "type": "per_unit", "rateCents": 1500 },
--                  "sales":    { "type": "percent_bps", "bps": 200 },
--                  "kpi":      { "type": "per_unit", "rateCents": 5000, "required": true } } }
-- "required": true means the period MUST have that performance input or the
-- staff member's payroll line is flagged incomplete.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE incentive_schemes (
  id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name             VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  rule_definition  JSONB NOT NULL,
  active           BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at       TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE performance_inputs (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pay_period_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pay_periods(id),
  staff_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES staff(id),
  metric_type    performance_metric_type NOT NULL,
  metric_value   NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,           -- units for sessions/enrolments/kpi, dollars for sales
  created_at     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- payroll_lines (OWNED BY UC-003)
-- Money columns are NUMERIC(12,2) dollars in the DB; all JavaScript math is done
-- in integer cents and converted at the model boundary (see utils/money.js).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE payroll_lines (
  id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pay_period_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pay_periods(id),
  staff_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES staff(id),
  gross_pay         NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- part-timer hours x rate (OT/PH applied)
  incentive_amount  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- full-timer performance incentive
  cpf_employee      NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cpf_employer      NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sdl               NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  other_deductions  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  net_pay           NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  line_status       payroll_line_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete',
  notes             TEXT,                              -- reason a line was flagged incomplete
  created_at        TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (pay_period_id, staff_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- approvals (UC-004)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE approvals (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pay_period_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pay_periods(id),
  decision       approval_decision NOT NULL,
  approved_by    VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  comment        TEXT,                               -- required on reject (enforced in service)
  decided_at     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- payment_batches (UC-005)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE payment_batches (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  pay_period_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pay_periods(id),
  file_format    payment_file_format NOT NULL DEFAULT 'giro',
  file_path      VARCHAR(500),
  status         payment_batch_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generated',
  generated_at   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- audit_logs (shared; written only through services/auditService.js)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
  id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entity_type  VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,                -- e.g. pay_period, payroll_line
  entity_id    UUID NOT NULL,
  action       VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,                -- e.g. validated, payroll_calculated, approved
  actor        VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  detail       JSONB,
  created_at   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_timesheets_period ON timesheets(pay_period_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_payroll_lines_period ON payroll_lines(pay_period_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_performance_inputs_period ON performance_inputs(pay_period_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_entity ON audit_logs(entity_type, entity_id);
